scope: Project survey invitation service, email templates and restored dispatch regression
behavior: Invitation service accepts exactly one ticket or project, loads tenant-scoped subject metadata and persists the matching subject column.
Project completion subscriber passes projectId; the previously skipped dispatch test now runs and passes.
Actual DatabaseTemplateProcessor renders project-specific emails in all eight supported template languages. The generated public token resolves and accepts feedback.
Ticket and project reminders carry correct identity; generic transport failure removes invitations and emits no sent event; foreign-tenant contacts cannot receive invitations.
Template migration is idempotent and supports down/up without deleting ticket templates.
Dispatch suite bootstrapped a new task-owned PostgreSQL database through the current CE migration chain and seeds. Journey suite also passed against that freshly migrated schema.
limits: Email transport is captured, not actual SMTP; event publication is captured, not broker delivery.
Analytics and response UI still need project-aware subjects.
Existing special handling that treats unverified-domain email failure as success remains to review.
Citus full migration chain and native candidate CI are not proven by this local PostgreSQL evidence.
